turns.speaker: user
turns.text: When am I supposed to prune roses? My mother in law says February, the internet says everything.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Late winter is a good rule for most shrub roses, just as the buds start to swell. So February or early March, depending on where you live.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, she wins this round. How much do I cut off?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Roughly a third to a half. Take out anything dead or crossing first, then cut just above an outward facing bud.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: pointing away from the middle of the bush?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly. That keeps the centre open so air moves through, which helps stop black spot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the climbing one on the fence? Same treatment?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Gentler. Tie the long canes in sideways and just shorten the little side shoots to a couple of buds.
